_comment: Read by the app's fetchUpdateStatus() (lib/core/update_check.dart). Bump latestBuild + latestVersion on EVERY store release. Android has no other source of truth: iOS cross-checks Apple's public iTunes lookup, Android does not, so if this file is missing or stale Android users are never told an update exists. Do NOT set minBuild unless you intend to hard-block older builds from opening.
